Open items (also stated wherever the affected number appears)

  • Per-model cacheable minimums not yet simulated → 34.3% may overstate on some models.
  • Anthropic batch rate NOW catalogued (2026-10-27): the pricing page states a definitive "Save 50% with batch processing", so Anthropic batch events price natively at half standard. The workload matrix now evaluates batch-routing against caching per shape and picks the cheaper (evals/run-workload-matrix.ts).
  • Package freshness gate and automated CJS smoke not yet in the build script (the CJS tarball was smoke-tested manually at 4e51734).
  • The banded figures are simulator-measured. A first real-traffic export exists (30 requests, see the table) and found one lever losing money on one-shot traffic — fixed at ec191c5 and re-verified. The bands stay simulator-labelled until a pilot-scale export replaces them.

Independent sources cited on the comparison page

  • codepointer.dev — 614M-token replay of rtk/headroom/caveman: 3.7% actual.
  • archestra.ai — progressive disclosure: ~77% modelled vs ~13% measured.
  • RouterArena (arXiv:2510.00202) — independent router leaderboard.
  • Anthropic & OpenAI published pricing pages — all rates in packages/core/src/model-prices.ts carry source URL and capture date.
